summary.text: Ask for your household or means information to be reassessed through the MediShield Life e-Service or by phone.

details.heading: If more information is needed
details.body: MOH will contact you if it needs further clarification on your request.

steps.name: Request a reassessment
steps.text: Submit your request through the MediShield Life e-Service, or call the hotline at 1800-222-3399.

items: Submit your request through the MediShield Life e-Service at https://medishieldlife.moh.gov.sg/.

about.text: This can reassess your household information, your means information, or both for MediShield Life Premium Subsidies and other selected healthcare schemes.

example_phrasings: How can I have my means test reassessed?
Can I ask for my means test to be reviewed?
How do I get my household information reassessed?

sources.page_title: I am applying for subsidy from another healthcare scheme, but was directed to approach MediShield Life. What can I do to have my means-test result reassessed so that I can be eligible for higher subsidy?

quotes.text: To reassess your household and/or means information for MediShield Life Premium Subsidies and/or other selected healthcare schemes, please submit your request via the MediShield Life e-Service (https://medishieldlife.moh.gov.sg/).
